summary: Tested the two reported fixes: (1) Excel import setting group_month, (2) Company Name / Contact Number no longer mandatory. Fix 1 VERIFIED working (backend + UI). Fix 2 only partially done: UI labels/required attrs cleaned up, but POST /api/loans still returns 422 because LoanApplicationCreate declares company_name and contact_no as required, and the Add form does not send those keys at all -> adding an entry without touching Company/Contact fails.

critical.issue: 422 Unprocessable Entity when company_name / contact_no are omitted. LoanApplicationCreate (server.py ~L192-196) still declares 'company_name: str' and 'contact_no: str' as required. MonthlyMIS Add form initialises newLoanData = { month } only, so both keys are absent in the payload and every 'Add Entry' without typing a company/contact fails. Reproduced in UI (console 422 + toast 'Failed to add loan') and in pytest. Fix: make both Optional[str] = "".

minor.issue: Response key is 'imported' (not 'imported_count'); duplicates/skipped keys OK. Only a contract/naming note for consumers.

ui_bugs.issue: Company Name <Input> still has the `required` attribute when masterCompanies is empty (line ~1387). Same in Edit form (line ~1633). With master companies seeded a Select is rendered so it is currently masked, but on a fresh/empty master the field is still mandatory.

Cannot save an imported row: imported loans store month='Apr-2026' (MMM-YYYY), handleEditOpen only parses dd-mm-yyyy so editMonthInput stays empty and the required 'Date *' input blocks submit with native 'Please fill out this field'. User must manually set a date before any edit of imported rows.
Generic toast 'Failed to add loan' / 'Failed to update loan'; backend validation detail (422 field errors) is not surfaced, making the company_name/contact_no failure invisible to users.
Month * dropdown lists only existing month groups + empty month groups; a brand new month must be created via Add Month first before it can be imported into.

action_items: server.py LoanApplicationCreate: change company_name and contact_no to Optional[str] = "" (this is the actual blocker for requirement 2).
MonthlyMIS.jsx lines ~1387 and ~1633: remove `required` from the Company Name fallback <Input> in both Add and Edit forms.
Surface backend error detail in handleAddLoan/handleEditSave toasts instead of a generic message.
Edit dialog: prefill/relax the required Date field for rows whose month is stored as MMM-YYYY (imported rows) so they can be edited.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend-only removal of the '*' and `required` attributes does not make a field optional - the Pydantic create model is the source of truth and still rejects missing company_name/contact_no with 422.
MonthlyMIS.jsx is ~2000+ lines; add/edit forms are near-duplicated (company/location/manager selects repeated) - extract a shared LoanForm component.
import endpoint returns errors list but the UI only console.logs them; surface partial-failure rows to the user.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/MonthlyMIS.jsx (added missing data-testids only: import-month-select, import-file-input, import-submit-btn, add-entry-submit-btn, edit-save-btn)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted loans TEST_IMP_Alpha, TEST_IMP_Beta (API import) and TEST_UI_Import_One (UI import via /tmp/qa_import.xlsx). All removed with /app/backend/tests/cleanup_import_qa.py - verified 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED WORKING: POST /api/import/loans-excel with month=Apr-2026 sets both month and group_month to 'Apr-2026'; imported rows show up immediately in the Apr-2026 group on the MIS page (fetchLoans refresh works, no manual navigation needed) and persist after reload. Duplicate detection returns duplicates=2 on re-import. VERIFIED: 'Company Name' and 'Contact Number' labels have no '*' in both Add and Edit dialogs, Contact Number input has no required attr. STILL BROKEN: Add Entry without Company/Contact -> 422 from POST /api/loans (backend model). Nav item is labelled 'Month MIS' (route /monthly-mis), month groups are collapsed by default. New testids added: import-month-select, import-file-input, import-submit-btn, add-entry-submit-btn, edit-save-btn. Regression tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_import_group_month.py; cleanup: python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_import_qa.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Requirement 2 was implemented only in the React layer (removed '*' from labels and the `required` attr on the Contact input). The FastAPI create model LoanApplicationCreate still types company_name and contact_no as non-optional str, and the Add-Entry handler seeds newLoanData with just { month }, so the JSON body omits both keys -> Pydantic raises 422 'Field required' for company_name and contact_no and the UI shows a generic 'Failed to add loan' toast. Additionally the Company Name fallback <Input> (rendered when masterCompanies is empty) still carries `required` in both the Add and Edit forms.
